title: Add perf baseline drift dashboards + warn-only alert rules (link to run metadata)
author: Sergio Costa
release_notes: Internal: Adds Grafana dashboard + warn-only alerting for perf baseline drift by model/region/hardware/traffic_shape, with links to perf-canary run metadata.
body:
## Summary This PR adds the initial Grafana dashboard JSON and alerting rules for the Q1 2026 perf baseline suite. Alerts are explicitly **warn-only** (non-paging) and are intended to surface potential drift/regressions early, with direct links back to the perf-canary run metadata/artifacts to speed triage.

This is the observability half of the baseline rollout: perf-canary produces the run artifacts; this PR adds the dashboard + alerts that consume the normalized metrics and expose the required dimensions.

## What’s included - Grafana dashboard: **Perf Baseline Drift (Warn-only)** with required dimensions: `model`, `model_version`, `traffic_shape`, `region`, `hardware_sku`, `quant_profile`, plus `runner_env` (driver/CUDA/runtime build stamp). - Panels (high level): 1) Drift heatmap: p95 TTFT delta vs baseline by model x traffic_shape (last N runs) 2) Tail latency: p99 end-to-end latency and p99 TPOT (overlaid baseline) 3) Throughput: tokens/sec and req/sec (with baseline line) 4) Variance diagnostics: run-to-run stddev, sample size, and “variance budget” thresholds 5) Runner health: missing series, artifact upload failures, run duration outliers 6) Annotations: baseline refresh events + fleet/driver changes (from run metadata tags)

- Alert rules (warn-only): - `perf_baseline_ttft_p95_drift_warn` - `perf_baseline_tpot_p95_drift_warn` - `perf_baseline_e2e_p99_drift_warn` - `perf_baseline_throughput_drop_warn` - `perf_baseline_missing_dimensions_warn` (guards against cardinality issues / schema drift)

Each alert includes: - labels for `model`, `traffic_shape`, `region`, `hardware_sku` (kept intentionally bounded; see Cardinality section) - annotation with a deep link to the run metadata in perf-canary (run_id, commit SHA, runner env)

## Linking to run metadata The dashboard and alerts link to perf-canary’s run metadata page using `run_id` (from metric label) and `git_sha` (from metric label). Example annotation template: `Run: {{ $labels.run_id }} | SHA: {{ $labels.git_sha }} | Metadata: https://perf-canary.redwood.ai/runs/{{ $labels.run_id }}`

Note: `run_id` is only emitted for baseline runs (nightly/weekly). PR-level perf-smoke runs are intentionally excluded for now to keep noise down.

## PromQL / rule behavior (high level) We measure drift relative to the stored baseline series per dimension:
- Drift definition: `(current - baseline) / baseline` on the same dimension set.
- Windows: `current` uses last successful run; baseline is pinned to the baseline tag.
- Thresholds: aligned to the variance budget doc (warn-only here): - TTFT p95 drift: > 8% for 2 consecutive runs - TPOT p95 drift: > 6% for 2 consecutive runs - E2E p99 drift: > 10% for 2 consecutive runs - Throughput drop: > 7% for 2 consecutive runs

Illustrative snippet (one of the rules): `(
  perf_baseline_ttft_seconds_p95{suite="q1-2026"}
  /
  perf_baseline_ttft_seconds_p95{suite="q1-2026", series="baseline"}
) - 1 > 0.08`

## Cardinality & cost controls - We avoid embedding `customer_id`, `tenant`, or request-route labels. - Alerts only group by the bounded dimension set: `model`, `traffic_shape`, `region`, `hardware_sku`. - Dashboard supports filtering by additional labels (e.g., quant profile), but panels default to safe aggregation and require opt-in toggles for higher-cardinality views.

## Files added/changed - `grafana/dashboards/perf_baseline_drift_warn_only.json` - `grafana/dashboards/perf_baseline_drift_warn_only.readme.md` (panel intent + dimensions contract) - `alerts/perf_baseline_drift_warn_only.rules.yaml` - `alerts/perf_baseline_drift_warn_only.tests.yaml` - `alerts/common/run_metadata_links.libsonnet` (shared link templates) - `dashboards/lib/variables.libsonnet` (adds traffic_shape + hardware_sku variables) - `docs/perf-baseline-dashboards.md`

## Testing / validation - `make lint` - `make grafana:validate` (dashboard JSON schema + UID checks) - `make promtool:test` (alert rule unit tests with synthetic series) - Verified in staging Grafana: filters behave as expected; links resolve for sample run_id.

## Rollout plan - Merge → deploy to staging → 48h observation → deploy to prod Grafana. - Alerts stay **warn-only** until the perf gate rollout plan advances to soft/hard fail in CI (separate track).

## Notes / follow-ups - Follow-up PR to add annotations for baseline refresh events via deploy markers from Release Eng (not blocked on this). - If we see noise in p99, we may switch the p99 alert to require 3 consecutive runs or increase the hold time.

## Related - Linear: ENG-4830 (Baseline dashboard buildout), ENG-4827 (Nightly perf-canary baseline integration) - Runtime baseline effort: Q1 2026 perf baseline suite

---

### Review conversation (condensed) Allison Grant (review): Dashboard looks good. Two asks: (1) please clarify in the readme that alerts are non-paging + won’t gate releases; (2) can we keep `quant_profile` out of alert labels for now to avoid blowups when we add new profiles? Sergio Costa (author): Updated readme to call out warn-only/non-paging and removed `quant_profile` from alert group_by; kept it as a dashboard variable only.

Aisha Bello (review): For TTFT, can you confirm we’re using the server-side definition consistent with the baseline methodology? Also please add a panel that makes missing-series obvious (we keep getting "flat" dashboards when a region is down). Sergio Costa (author): Confirmed metrics are the server-side TTFT series emitted by perf-canary ingestion (not client TTFT). Added "Missing series / last successful run" row with per-region last_seen and missing dimension counts.

Thomas Baird (review): +1 on bounded labels. One more: can we add a guard alert for new/unexpected label values (traffic_shape taxonomy drift)? Sergio Costa (author): Added `perf_baseline_missing_dimensions_warn` that fires when expected dimension tuples have no data for > 2 runs, and a second check that flags unknown traffic_shape values against an allowlist.

Marcus Reed (review): Looks aligned with the suite. Please link to the run metadata and include runner env (driver/CUDA/runtime build) in the dashboard so we can spot env drift quickly. Sergio Costa (author): Added runner env row + included `runner_env` in hover + panel description; alerts include runner env in annotations (not labels).

### CI - ✅ build (observability-pack) - ✅ lint - ✅ grafana validate - ✅ promtool tests

### Merge Squash-merged into `main` as: "Add perf baseline drift dashboard + warn-only alerts"
